text: This report outlines the need for appointments of Board of Health members to two Committees of the Board of Health and one external Board for 2023: - the Board of Health - Budget Committee, - the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee, and - the Association of Local Public Health Agencies' (alPHa) Board of Directors and Board of Health Section. Toronto Public Health will report back to the Board of Health with recommendations for the appointment of members to the Toronto Drug Secretariat Implementation Panel pending the release of the updated Toronto Drug Strategy later this year.

The Board of Health: 1. Appointed the following Board of Health directors to the Board of Health Budget Committee for a term of office ending on December 31, 2023, and until successors are appointed: Director Chris Moise Director Gord Perks Director Alejandra Bravo Director Ramanjeet Singh Director Suman Roy 2. Appointed the following Board of Health directors to the Board of Health Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee for a term of office ending on December 31, 2023, and until successors are appointed: Director Chris Moise Director Abinaya Chandrabalan Director Stephanie Zhou Director Ausma Malik 3.
